headline_marked: [[Jaya Ahsan's 'Aajo Ardhangini' now on OTT]] after 75-day theatrical run
headline: Jaya Ahsan's 'Aajo Ardhangini' now on OTT after 75-day theatrical run
summary: The film, a sequel to 'Ardhangini', achieved "blockbuster hit" status and garnered critical acclaim for its compelling story and performances, especially Jaya Ahsan's portrayal of Meghna.
details: Director Kaushik Ganguly recently shared the poster of his latest film, 'Aajo Ardhangini', which completed an impressive 75-day theatrical run since its release on July 10. The production house hailed it as a "blockbuster hit" for its sustained success.

This film is a sequel to Ganguly's commercially successful 2023 movie 'Ardhangini'. It features Churni Ganguly, Jaya Ahsan, Kaushik Sen, and Ambarish Bhattacharya in the principal roles, with Jaya Ahsan reprising her character Meghna.

Jaya Ahsan expressed her delight at the film's success, attributing it to a strong story and compelling content. She noted that the audience's enthusiastic response, including applause for dialogues and emotional connection, proves that good films continue to draw viewers to cinemas.

The actress further emphasized her satisfaction, stating, "I am very happy because I have been able to do a work that has actually influenced people's daily relationships." She considers the ongoing discussions and continued viewership of the film as her greatest achievement.

Critics widely praised Jaya Ahsan's performance. Sangbad Pratidin, in its review, described her as "perfect" in the role of Meghna, highlighting her "tumultuous, overflowing liquidity and fluidity" that captivated audiences.

Online platform The Wall observed Jaya Ahsan's restrained yet impactful portrayal of Meghna. It noted her ability to convey a woman trapped between guilt, hesitation, love, and uncertainty, with her scenes alongside Churni Ganguly deepening the film's emotional core.

The Telegraph also commended Jaya Ahsan's strong support in her role. Despite fewer opportunities for overt emotional expression compared to the first film, she effectively conveyed Meghna's fragile mental state through her composed and believable acting.

Following its tremendous success in theaters, 'Aajo Ardhangini' is now available for streaming on the OTT platform Hoichoi starting today, Friday. Audiences in Bangladesh can also enjoy watching Jaya Ahsan's acclaimed film from home.

headline_marked: [[Tigresses to face China]] in friendly match today ahead of Asian Games semifinal
headline: Tigresses to face China in friendly match today ahead of Asian Games semifinal
summary: The Bangladesh women's cricket team will play a friendly against China today. This comes after their Asian Games quarterfinal against China was abandoned, with Bangladesh advancing to the semifinals based on ranking.
details: The Bangladesh women's cricket team, known as the Tigresses, is set to play a friendly match against China today. This encounter serves as preparation for their upcoming Asian Games semifinal.
Their previous quarterfinal match against China in the Asian Games was abandoned without a single ball being bowled. Bangladesh advanced to the semifinals based on their superior ranking.
Bangladesh team manager S M Golam Faiyaz confirmed the friendly, stating, "They have requested us to play a friendly match and we will play the match tomorrow."
The Tigresses are scheduled to face India in their semifinal match on Sunday. India secured their spot in the last four by defeating hosts Japan by eight wickets.
The other semifinal clash on Sunday will feature Pakistan and Sri Lanka. All teams are vying for a place in the coveted Asian Games final.
caption:
Bangladesh's Tigresses are set to play a friendly match against China today. This comes just before their crucial Asian Games semifinal clash against India.

The Bangladesh women's cricket team, known as the Tigresses, is set to play a friendly match against China today. This encounter serves as preparation for their upcoming Asian Games semifinal.

Their previous quarterfinal match against China in the Asian Games was abandoned without a single ball being bowled. Bangladesh advanced to the semifinals based on their superior ranking.

Bangladesh team manager S M Golam Faiyaz confirmed the friendly, stating, "They have requested us to play a friendly match and we will play the match tomorrow."

The Tigresses are scheduled to face India in their semifinal match on Sunday. India secured their spot in the last four by defeating hosts Japan by eight wickets.

The other semifinal clash on Sunday will feature Pakistan and Sri Lanka. All teams are vying for a place in the coveted Asian Games final.
